create_audiovisual_dataset: create an AudioVisualDataset instance from a pickle file containing feature paths and labels
create_training_dataset: create a training dataset with the feature_collate_train collate function for audio-visual data loading
create_validation_dataset: create a validation dataset with the feature_collate_val collate function for audio-visual data loading
review_feature_collate_train: review the feature_collate_train function that pads and processes batches with random max clip length
review_feature_collate_val: review the feature_collate_val function that pads and processes batches using full video length
